verdict.rationale: Grok Build ships a first-party `/loop` command that runs a prompt on a recurring interval (e.g. `/loop 5m` to check the test suite). It runs alongside background commands, subagents and monitors, so the core recurring-schedule capability is delivered by the product itself rather than a one-off action. The docs tie it to an ongoing conversation, so how far it extends beyond that is unclear. Missing for 10: evidence of persistent scheduling outside an active session (cron-style or calendar schedules), management of scheduled jobs (listing, pausing, cancelling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: `/loop` runs a prompt on a recurring interval
/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.
